close_reason: Verified in code — implementation matches decision exactly.
description: The handler checks whether the target email already has keywords/$mdnsent: true before delegating to backend.send_mdns. This prevents double-send regardless of which backend is used. The backend does not need to know about the JMAP keyword; the handler owns the guard. Oracle: draft-ietf-jmap-mdn-17 §2.1.
title: DECISION:  pre-send guard in handler, not backend
